about:
I grew up in Istanbul and moved to the US to study Biology at Brown. I've since gotten the opportunity to teach Immunology as an undergraduate TA, research neonatal brain injury at Women & Infants Hospital, and scrub into countless surgeries at an ENT institute back home. 

Somewhere in between I started building software too: a language-learning app people use every day, an e-ink flight information display, and a recipe site for my mom's kitchen narrated in five languages. Right now, I'm focused on improving my new Chromium-based web browser for daily use.

I graduate in May 2027 and I'm heading into consulting, strategy, and product development work next. When I'm not working, I'm probably studying a language, sketching interfaces, or figuring out what to build next.
